subject.title: [Feature]: Allow job-level model override for cron jobs using sessionTarget=main + payload.kind=systemEvent

question: Should OpenClaw support provider/model overrides for main-session `systemEvent` cron jobs, and if so what stable cron job contract should carry that override?
rationale: The issue asks for a new compatibility-sensitive cron/API behavior that crosses scheduling, provider routing, session state, persistence, docs, and UI/tool schema boundaries; the previous direct PR was closed unmerged after a contract bug, so automation should not choose the permanent shape alone.

options.title: Add an explicit cron override contract
options.body: Add a first-class job-level override shape with validation, documented precedence, persistence/schema/tool/UI support, and tests for both immediate and next-heartbeat execution.

options.title: Reuse `payload.model` for system events
options.body: Extend `systemEvent` payloads to accept `model` while still defining session-preference precedence and heartbeat transport safely.

options.title: Keep systemEvent text-only
options.body: Document this route as unsupported for explicit model calls and direct model-specific automation to isolated/current/custom-session `agentTurn` jobs.

recommendation.title: Add an explicit cron override contract
recommendation.body: Add a first-class job-level override shape with validation, documented precedence, persistence/schema/tool/UI support, and tests for both immediate and next-heartbeat execution.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest available recent history signal around cron runtime/schema direction and was also identified in prior issue review as the likely owner for this product-sensitive choice.
